title: Cover the entire H1 ball in L2 and price finite trial verification
statement: For mean-zero divfree H1 data with norm<=M, truncating |k|infinity<=N leaves L2 tail<=M/[2pi(N+1)]. Choose N and a finite rational coefficient grid so tail and rounding fit the requested L2 radius. Rational projectors I-kk^T/|k|^2 for nonzero k and conjugate pairing produce finite real divfree mean-zero centers, with computable cardinality/bit heights/controlled H1 enlargement. This covers the entire infinite-dimensional preparation ball, not a finite-input replacement. Finite spatial-trigonometric/time-polynomial trials admit finite computable residual, endpoint and integrated-sixth-power certificates with rational rounding. Combined with the preceding inequality, such verified data would certify all nearby inputs/all admitted weak realizations. No PDE-solution oracle, stochastic common-seed selection or proof a passing universal certificate exists is supplied; the net and stability can have circular parameter dependence in a naive probability argument. An explicit canonical net uses N=ceil(4M/q),Delta=q/[1000(N+1)^3]. Truncation tail<q/24; symmetric rational grids on[-M-1,M+1], rational Leray projectors and reality pairing give grid L2 error<.013q and H1 error<q/4. Retain centers whose RATIONAL upper H1-square sum_k[1+(44/7)^2|k|^2]|c_k|^2<=4M^2. The nearest grid point survives since its upper norm<(22/21)M+q/4<2M; every retained center has actual H1<=2M. Cardinality is bounded by[1+ceil(2(M+1)/Delta)]^[6(2N+1)^3]. Finite trial/control polynomials admit rational Fourier/time integrals for sixth powers/endpoints/A2 and sound residual bounds using a certificate-supplied finite pi interval. Reject uncertified inequalities at that finite precision; no unbounded precision loop. P has K+1 ORDINARY binary digits and all enormous net/materialisation/description costs are charged. No input-polynomial or accepting-certificate existence claim follows.
